project.name: Independent Sparse Quantum State Preparation Implementation

comparison_methods.blocked_reason: A version-pinned adapter and common input/output normalization must be added during Phase 9.2 before numeric comparisons are published.

support.purpose: General random distinct supports; canonical scaling family.
Boundary family with support already in the compact subspace.
Stress common prefixes and distinct residual suffixes; eligible only when s <= 2**(n-ceil(log2(s))).

coefficients.purpose: Equal positive real magnitudes; isolates isometry cost.
Normalized complex Gaussian coefficients; exercises coefficient phase preparation.

sign_profiles.purpose: Independent Algorithm 3 sign metadata, generated from the same seed.

measurement_policy.memory: peak process resident set size; normalize to bytes and record OS/source
measurement_policy.confidence_interval: 95% bootstrap interval over independent seeds; do not bootstrap repeated timings as independent problem instances
measurement_policy.randomness: Every support/coefficient/sign generator receives the recorded seed. Store generator ID and seed in every record.
measurement_policy.warmup_and_repetitions: Use tier settings. Never merge warm-up timings into measured repetitions.
measurement_policy.timeouts: A timeout is a recorded outcome, not a missing row. Record elapsed time, timeout threshold and partial metrics if available.
measurement_policy.gpu_synchronization: Synchronize the active CUDA stream before and after timed GPU regions; report transfers separately where instrumented.
measurement_policy.thermal_policy: Record power mode, clocks if available, temperature if available, and idle/background-load notes. Do not compare runs with materially different throttling without flagging them.

statevector_verification.policy: Run only when the full circuit including marker and work ancillas fits the configured cap. Otherwise record statevector_status=not_run_resource_cap; never treat a skipped statevector check as a pass.

gpu_basis_batch.policy: Use only when CuPy and a CUDA device are detected; record GPU identity, transfer time, kernel time and synchronized wall time. This is not a GPU statevector simulator.

hardware_lanes.role: reference development, CPU construction, small exact statevector tests
single-GPU CuPy basis-row batch parity and throughput where CUDA is available
higher-throughput CPU/GPU repeatability and larger basis-row batches
controlled accelerator throughput, per-device memory behavior and parallel independent workload sweeps
